{{Quote|I am your empress, Niin! Remember your vows!|Empress Elliah, moments before her murder by Eshkar Niin|<ref name="Legacy War 2" />}}
'''Elliah Fel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Legacy 50" /> who was [[Empress/Legends|Empress]]<ref name="Legacy War 2" /> of the [[Fel Empire]] ruled by Emperor [[Roan Fel]], with whom she had a [[Parent/Legends|daughter]], [[Marasiah Fel]].<ref name="Legacy 50" /> Her brother, the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Hogrum Chalk]], characterized both mother and daughter as warriors who sacrificed much for the Empire.<ref name="Legacy War 1" />

Prior to [[137 ABY]],<ref name="Legacy 50" /> the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Darth Havok|Eshkar Niin]] [[Rooftop duel|dueled]] her on the rooftop of a [[City/Legends|city]] building in the presence of his apprentice, [[Antares Draco]],<ref name="Legacy War 2" /> who had been sent to kill his former master for abandoning the vows of an Imperial Knight.<ref name="Legacy 50" /> Although the Empress defended herself with a [[Imperial Knight lightsaber|lightsaber]] for some time, she was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by the traitor. Draco then attacked and believed he had succeeded in killing Niin; however, the Iktotchi faked his defeat and death to escape and become Darth Havok of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith]].<ref name="Legacy War 2" />

Elliah's death strained the Empire's relations with the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. The [[Hapan]]s saw her death as Roan Fel's fault, since Niin was his knight.<ref name="Legacy War 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Elliah was first mentioned in the [[Legacy (2006) 50|final issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''.<ref name="Legacy 50" /> She appeared via flashback and was identified as Elliah in [[Legacy — War 2|''Legacy—War'' 2]].<ref name="Legacy War 2" />
